Finds the RHYTHM track for the step-record screen: the first of the 16 tracks whose TRACK ASSIGN value (0xF1A0[t]) is 16; when its bit is set in the track mask word 0xFFEC (VoiceState_DataBlock2_Tbl = 1 << t) and the track holds data (bit 7 of 0xF250[3t]), returns W = t + 1, stores it in 0x0D56 and sets 0x0D54 bit 0 and 0x287B bit 2; otherwise clears both and returns W = 0.

why_refused: Mechanics are clear, meaning is not. SqStep_SetupCursorTrack calls it last and its header does not cover it. In display mode 3 (RHYTHM track) it walks every other used track (TRACK ASSIGN != 16), rewinds that track's cursor, counts its 0x81 markers to the end and sets word 0x0D6B = count - 1 whenever count >= the current value (so not a plain maximum), or 0xFFFF and stops when the track ends on 0x84; the cursor track is kept in 0x0E46 and restored.
